easyPrerequisites: You control at least eight lands.
description:
Activate eight lands by tapping them, creating eight Food, eight Treasure and eight Clue tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {8}.
Activate four remaining tokens by paying a total of {8}, tapping and sacrificing them, causing you to gain 12 life.
Activate a Food using Beledros's ability by paying 10 life, untapping all lands you control.
Repeat.
